details:
Q1. What should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or script in this repo; I will name the file/path or phase (RECOMMENDED)
B. A user-facing behavior in the AI pipeline; I will describe the current problem and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
C. A reliability/performance issue; I will describe the failing or slow behavior and where it occurs
D. A documentation/readability improvement only
Q2. What kind of change is expected?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug or broken behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add a new capability
C. Improve maintainability/refactor existing code without changing behavior
D. Improve docs/configuration only
Q3. How should success be judged?
Choices:
A. A concrete before/after behavior or acceptance criterion; I will provide it (RECOMMENDED)
B. Match an existing pattern elsewhere in this repo; I will point to the reference file/path
C. Use my general intent only, no specific acceptance criteria
Q4. Are there any scope limits or constraints?
Choices:
A. Keep changes minimal and local; avoid behavior changes outside the named area (RECOMMENDED)
B. Broader cleanup/refactor is acceptable if it helps
C. Workflow files under `.github/workflows/` must not be changed
D. No special constraints
